description.en:
Creates the two-line caption shown when a Fighting Spirit move is performed ("ava" is short for avatar, the engine's internal word for a Fighting Spirit).

The sixth argument is a Fighting Spirit ID such as "ck0023". Its name text in the game's text tables contains a line break. The engine splits it there and makes two separate named captions:
- the part before the line break goes into the caption named by the second argument, and its size is written into the eighth argument;
- the part after the line break goes into the caption named by the first argument, and its size is written into the seventh argument.
If the ID is not a known Fighting Spirit, nothing is created and the function returns null.

Both captions are coloured from the Fighting Spirit's data entry (the same five colours as CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP) and are created hidden. Show them with CMND_2DO_STATE_DRAW_TELOP.
The shipped script builds the ID from the move script name with MakeKsnFileName, which turns "vkaNNNN" into "ckNNNN".
Name to register the main caption (the text after the line break) under.
Name to register the second caption (the text before the line break) under.

Passed unchanged to the engine's 2D object creation call for the main caption. Meaning not identified.
The shipped script passes 0.

Passed unchanged to the same creation call. Meaning not identified.
The shipped script passes 12.

Passed unchanged to the same creation call. Meaning not identified.
The shipped script passes 0.
Fighting Spirit ID whose name is displayed, e.g. "ck0023".
OUTPUT. Receives the main caption's [width, height] in pixels. Pass a 2-element array such as [0, 0].

OUTPUT. Receives the second caption's [width, height] in pixels.
The engine writes into it only if it is an array: the shipped script passes a Vecter2 object (preset to 256 x 64), which the engine cannot size, so that object keeps its preset values.

Base spacing between characters, used while laying out and measuring the text. Required here because the function checks for all 9 arguments.
The shipped script passes 6.

null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 9 arguments were given, or the ID is not a known Fighting Spirit.
On success the native reports a result without pushing one, so Squirrel hands back the last argument you passed (never null).

examples.case: Fighting Spirit move caption (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_skl.nut; caption names shortened from the script's Shift-JIS names)
